## 1401 - 1402

These exceptions are part of the Scheduled Movement Reconciliation add-on.

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="1401">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1401 - SMR - Schedule not found for batch</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="1401">

A scheduled movement could not be found for the meter batch. If a meter is configured to Reconcile Volume (Meter Editor \> Liquids tab \> Setup sub-tab), each batch must have a corresponding scheduled movement. This exception will auto-resolve if the batch is later matched to a new or updated schedule.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="1402">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1402 - SMR - Sum of matched batches exceeds scheduled quantity</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="1402">

When a batch is matched to a schedule, a check is made to determine if the scheduled quantity, plus a tolerance amount, has been exceeded by the sum of all currently matched batches. This exception indicates that the sum of the currently matched batched exceed the scheduled amount. This exception will not auto-resolve.

</div>

</div>
